Firefox Affiliate buttons are bits of HTML code that you put on your website or blog to encourage visitors to download Firefox. When someone clicks a button on your site and visits the Firefox download page, you get credit for that click.

Firefox Affiliate banneri predstavljaju dio HTML kôda kojeg postavljate na Vašu web stranicu ili blog kako biste potaknuli posjetitelje na preuzimanje Firefoxa. Kada posjetitelj klikne na banner koji ste postavili na stranicu i posjeti Firefox stranicu za preuzimanje, Vama će pripasti zasluga za taj klik.

Firefox Affiliates allows you to build banners and place them on your Facebook profile to encourage visitors to download Firefox. When a visitor to your page or status update clicks on a banner and visits the Firefox download page, you get credit for that click. Affiliates who get a lot of clicks through their profile will be featured on our leaderboard and be elegible for fun stuff like Firefox T-shirts. While we do send out prizes and gifts to our Affiliates from time to time, Firefox Affiliates does not offer monetary rewards for hosting Firefox banners.

Kada posjetitelj klikne na banner kojeg ste postavili na stranicu i preuzme Firefox, vama pripada zasluga za to preuzimanje. Affiliate članovi koji ostvare velik broj preuzimanja, bit će objavljeni na popisu vodećih članova, te će biti kvalificirani za dobivanje zanimljivih nagrada, poput Firefox majice. Iako povremeno šaljemo nagrade i poklone našim affiliate članovima, Firefox Affiliate program ne isplaćuje novac u razmjenu za objavljene bannere.

Firefox Affiliates allows you to build banners and place them on your Facebook profile to encourage visitors to download Firefox. When a visitor to your page or status update clicks on a banner and visits the Firefox download page, you get credit for that click. Affiliates who get a lot of clicks through their profile will be featured on our leaderboard and be eligible for fun stuff like Firefox T-shirts and, if you opt in, we may feature your banner in a paid-ad on the Facebook ad network. While we do send out prizes and gifts to our Affiliates from time to time, Firefox Affiliates does not offer monetary rewards for hosting Firefox banners.

Firefox Affiliate banneri predstavljaju dio HTML kôda kojeg postavljate na vašu web stranicu ili blog kako biste potaknuli posjetitelje na preuzimanje Firefoxa. Affiliate članovi koji ostvare velik broj preuzimanja, bit će objavljeni na popisu vodećih članova, te će biti kvalificirani za dobivanje zanimljivih nagrada, poput Firefox majice. Iako povremeno šaljemo nagrade i poklone našim affiliate članovima, Firefox Affiliate program ne isplaćuje novac u razmjenu za objavljene bannere.

It’s super easy! To start, choose a button and select the Firefox product or campaign you’d like to support. From there, simply pick your button’s style, shape and color, and then copy and paste the code into the HTML of your site. Done! Your unique affiliate ID will be in the code to make sure you get credit for every click you send our way.

Jednostavno je! Krenite s odabirom bannera, odaberite Firefoxov proizvod ili kampanju koju želite podržati, odaberite dizajn bannera, oblik i boju, te kopirajte i zalijepite kod u HTML svoje web stranice. Vaš jedinstveni affiliate ID će biti uključen u kod kako bi Vam bila pripisana zasluga za svako ostvareno preuzimanje.
I want to help make Firefox Affiliates better. How can I get involved?

Leaderboard stats update every night at midnight Pacific Time. No need to keep hitting refresh over and over again to see how you’re doing. Just check in the next day to see your progress.

Sometimes we run special time-limited campaigns to encourage people to download Firefox. If you’re using an affiliate button for one of these campaigns, try to update your button as soon as you can. People who click on that button will be directed to a general Firefox download page. You’ll get credit for the click as an Affiliate, but you may not get credit for clicks for that specific campaign.

Ponekad vodimo posebne, kratkoročne kampanje za ohrabrivanje korisnika na preuzimanje Firefoxa. Ako koristite affiliate banner jedne od takvih kampanja, pokušajte ažurirati svoj banner čim prije. Korisnici koji kliknu na takav banner bit će preusmjereni na glavnu stranicu za preuzimanje Firefoxa. Dobit ćete zaslugu za preuzimanje, ali možda nećete dobiti zaslugu za tu kampanju.

Text links work very much like banners. You start by choosing the Firefox product or campaign you’d like to support, then select the text link you’d like to use. Copy and paste the link code into the HTML of your site, onto your email signature, or anywhere else you’d like to have it appear. Your unique affiliate ID will be in the code to make sure you get credit for every click you send our way.

Add-ons are small pieces of software that add new features or functionality to your installation of %(app_name)s. addons.mozilla.org, commonly known as "AMO", is Mozilla's official site for add-ons to Mozilla software, such as Firefox, Thunderbird, and SeaMonkey. Add-ons let you add new features and change the way your browser or application works. Take a look around and explore the thousands of ways to customize the way you do things online.

addons.mozilla.org, uobičajeno poznato kao „AMO”, je Mozillino službeno mjesto za dodavanja softvera Mozilla, kao što su Firefox, Thunderbird i SeaMonkey. Dodaci omogućuju dodavanje novih funkcija i mijenjanje načina rada preglednika ili programa. Pogledaj i istraži tisuće načina kako prilagoditi vlastite aktivnosti na internetu.

How are downloads counted?

Download counts are updated every evening and only include original add-on downloads, not updates. Downloads can be broken down by the specific source referring the download.

Kako se broje preuzimanja?

Broj preuzimanja aktualizira se svake večeri i uključuje samo preuzimanja izvornih dodataka, a ne nadogradnji. Preuzimanja je moguće navesti ovisno o specifičnom izvoru na koji se odnosi preuzimanje.

If an add-on isn't compatible with your version of %(app_name)s, it is usually either because your version of %(app_name)s is outdated or the add-on author has not yet updated the add-on to be compatible with a newer version you are using. Mozilla does not recommend trying to circumvent these compatibility checks, as they can lead to browser instability or in some cases loss of data. For users who are testing out alpha or beta versions of Firefox, we offer the Add-on Compatibility Reporter to help add-on developers update their compatibility.

Ako dodatak nije kompatibilan s Vašom inačicom %(app_name)s, obično je razlog ili taj što je inačica %(app_name)s zastarjela, ili da autor dodatka još nije ažurirao dodatak da bude kompatibilan s najnovijom inačicom koju koristite. Mozilla ne preporučuje pokušaje zaobilaženja ove provjere kompatibilnosti, jer oni mogu dovesti do nestabilnosti preglednika ili u nekim slučajevima do gubitka podataka. Za korisnike koji testiraju alfa ili beta inačicu Firefoxa, nudimo Izvjestitelja kompatibilnosti dodatka za pomoć programerima dodatka pri ažuriranju kompatibilnosti.

Anonymized user data like age, gender, and accent helps improve the audio data used to train the accuracy of speech recognition engines. Your username and email will never be associated with your submitted data, and you can choose whether to make your username public or anonymous.

Anonimizirani korisnički podatci, kao što su dob, rod i naglasak, pomažu u poboljšanju audio-podataka koji se koriste za uvježbavanje točnosti pogona za prepoznavanje govora. Tvoje korisničko ime i e-pošta nikada neće biti povezani s podnesenim podatcima i možeš birati hoće li tvoje korisničko ime biti javno ili anonimno.

A quiet background hubbub is OK, but we don’t want additional voices that may cause a machine algorithm to identify words that are not in the written text. If you can hear distinct words apart from those of the text, the clip should be rejected. Typically this happens where the TV has been left on, or where there is a conversation going on nearby.

The dataset currently consists of { $valid } validated hours in { $languages } languages, but we’re always adding more voices and languages. Take a look at our Languages page to request a language or start contributing.

Mnogi od { $total } zabilježenih sati u skupu podataka uključuju i demografske metapodatke poput dobi, spola i narječja, koji mogu pomoći u vježbanju točnosti govornih programa. Podaci se trenutačno sastoje od { $valid } potvrđenih sati za { $languages } jezika, no stalno dodajemo daljnje glasove i jezike. Na našoj stranici jezika možeš zatražiti jezik ili početi doprinositi.

Most of the data used by large companies isn’t available to the majority of people. We think that stifles innovation. So we’ve launched Common Voice, a project to help make voice recognition open and accessible to everyone.

Most recordings are of people talking in their natural voice. You can accept the occasional non-standard recording that is shouted, whispered, or obviously delivered in a ‘dramatic’ voice. Please reject sung recordings and those using a computer-synthesized voice.

Mozilla Common Voice is an initiative to help teach machines how real people speak.
Common Voice je Mozillina inicijativa koja pomaže strojevima govoriti ljudskim jezikom.

Mozilla Common Voice is made possible by a diverse community of activists, linguists, data scientists, academics and software engineers from all over the world. The project is stewarded by the Mozilla Foundation.
Mozilla Common Voice omogućuje zajednica aktivista, lingvista, podatkovnih znanstvenika, akademičara i softverskih inženjera iz cijelog svijeta. Projektom upravlja zaklada Mozilla Foundation.

Mozilla Common Voice is the world’s most diverse crowdsourced open speech dataset - and we’re powered entirely by donations. It costs almost a million dollars a year to host the datasets and improve the platform for the 100+ language communities who rely on what we do. If you value open, inclusive data - donate today!

Mozilla Common Voice je najraznolikija, otvorena zbirka glasovnih podataka na svijetu, i u potpunosti se financirmao donacijama. Spremanje skupova podataka i poboljšanje platforme za više od 100 jezičnih zajednica koje se oslanjaju na ono što mi radimo košta gotovo milijun dolara godišnje. Ako cijeniš otvorene, uključive podatke - doniraj danas!

We believe that large and publicly available voice datasets foster innovation and healthy commercial competition in machine-learning based speech technology. This is a global effort and we invite everyone to participate. Our aim is to help speech technology be more inclusive, reflecting the diversity of voices from around the world.

Vjerujemo da veliki i javno dostupni skupovi podataka glasa potiču inovacije i zdravu komercijalnu konkurenciju govorne tehnologije, utemeljene na strojnom učenju. Ovo je globalni napor i pozivamo na sudjelovanje. Naš je cilj, govornoj tehnologiji pomoći biti inkluzivnija, kako bi odražavala raznolikost glasova cijelog svijeta.

We believe that large, publicly available voice datasets will foster innovation and healthy commercial competition in machine-learning based speech technology.
Common Voice’s multi-language dataset is already the largest publicly available voice dataset of its kind, but it’s not the only one.
Look to this page as a reference hub for other open source voice datasets and, as Common Voice continues to grow, a home for our release updates.

We want speech models to be better at understanding a diverse range of speakers. For this to happen, a voice dataset must represent lots of different people.
Želimo da govorni modeli bolje razumiju različite govornike. Za to je potrebno da skup podataka govora mora predstavljati mnoge različite osobe.

We want the machine learning algorithms to able to handle a variety of background noise, and even relatively loud noises can be accepted provided that they don’t prevent you from hearing the entirety of the text. Quiet background music is OK; music loud enough to prevent you from hearing each and every word is not.

Želimo da algoritmi strojnog učenja mogu baratati šumovima u pozadini. Čak i relativno glasni šumovi mogu biti prihvaćeni pod uvjetom da ne sprečavaju čuti cijeli tekst. Tiha glazba u pozadini je u redu. Glasna glazba koja sprečava da čuješ svaku riječ nije.

European policy makers are making important decisions around copyright right now. Institutions like major press publishers and the recording industry are pushing their self-serving agenda. The Default Browser Agent task checks when the default changes from { -brand-short-name } to another browser. If the change happens under suspicious circumstances, it will prompt users to change back to { -brand-short-name } no more than two times. This task is installed automatically by { -brand-short-name }, and is reinstalled when { -brand-short-name } updates. To disable this task, update the “default-browser-agent.enabled” preference on the about:config page or the { -brand-short-name } enterprise policy setting “DisableDefaultBrowserAgent”.

Zadatak agenta standardnog preglednika provjerava kada se standardni preglednik promijeni iz { -brand-short-name } u jedan drugi preglednik. Ako se promjena dogodi pod sumnjivim okolnostima, od korisnika će se zatražiti da se vrate na { -brand-short-name } ne više od dva puta. Ovaj zadatak se automatski instalira od strane { -brand-short-name } i ponovo se instalira kada se { -brand-short-name } aktualizira. Za deaktiviranja ovog zadatka, aktualiziraj postavku “default-browser-agent.enabled” na stranici about:config ili { -brand-short-name } postavku pravila poduzeća “DisableDefaultBrowserAgent”.

The Default Browser Agent task checks when the default changes from %MOZ_APP_DISPLAYNAME% to another browser. If the change happens under suspicious circumstances, it will prompt users to change back to %MOZ_APP_DISPLAYNAME% no more than two times. This task is installed automatically by %MOZ_APP_DISPLAYNAME%, and is reinstalled when %MOZ_APP_DISPLAYNAME% updates. To disable this task, update the “default-browser-agent.enabled” preference on the about:config page or the %MOZ_APP_DISPLAYNAME% enterprise policy setting “DisableDefaultBrowserAgent”.

Ovaj zadatak se automatski instalira od strane %MOZ_APP_DISPLAYNAME% i ponovno se instalira kada se %MOZ_APP_DISPLAYNAME% ažurira. Da biste onemogućili ovaj zadatak, ažurirajte postavku “default-browser-agent.enabled” na stranici about:config ili %MOZ_APP_DISPLAYNAME% postavku pravila poduzeća “DisableDefaultBrowserAgent”.

{{brandShortName}} is built on free and open source software by a community of thousands from all over the world. There are a few things you should know:
{{brandShortName}} je slobodan program otvorenog kôda, izgrađen od strane zajednice tisuća programera iz cijelog svijeta. Trebali biste znati neke podatke:

{{brandShortName}} is made available to you under the terms of several open source licenses including the Mozilla Public License. A device running {{brandShortName}} may also contain proprietary software from third parties. Any code provided under open licenses give you the right to modify the source code and distribute your modified versions as long as you comply with their terms.

{{brandShortName}} je dostupan pod uvjetima nekoliko licenci otvorenog kôda, uključujući Mozillinu javnu licencu. Uređaj kojeg pokreće {{brandShortName}} može također sadržavati vlasnički softver trećih strana. Svi dijelovi kôda objavljeni pod otvorenim licencama daju vam pravo modificiranja izvornog kôda i daljnju distribuciju izmijenjenog kôda sve dok se pridržavate njihovih uvjeta.
{{brandShortName}} is the free and open source operating system from Mozilla. Our mission is to promote openness, innovation and opportunity by keeping the power of the Web in your hands.
{{brandShortName}} je Mozillin besplatan operativni sustav otvorenog kôda. Naša misija je promicanje otvorenosti, inovacija i prilika tako da snagu weba postavimo u vaše ruke.

{{brandShortName}} uses data such as GPS, Wi-Fi, and mobile networks near you to help determine your approximate location. Data is sent to Mozilla and other service providers and will be used in the aggregate to improve those location databases. Data may be stored on your device and data collection may occur even when no apps are running.

{{brandShortName}} koristi informacije od GPS-a, Wi-Fi-a i mobilnih mreža u važoj blizini kako bi lakše procijenio vašu lokaciju. Podaci se šalju Mozilli i ostalim pružateljima usluga, te se koriste za unaprijeđenje geolokacijskih baza podataka. Podaci se mogu spremati na vaš uređaj, a prikupljanje podataka se može obavljati čak i kad aplikacije nisu pokrenute.

The Mozilla Foundation is a California non-profit corporation exempt from United States federal income taxation under IRC 501(c)(3) and a public charity classified under IRC sections 170(b)(1)(A) and 509(a)(1). Bitcoin donations Mozilla receives are considered charitable contributions under U.S. federal tax laws, to be used in its discretion for its charitable purposes. If you have questions, check out our FAQ or contact us at donate@mozilla.org.

Mozilla Foundation je neprofitna korporacija iz države Kalifornije izuzeta od oporezivanja prihoda na temelju zakona IRC 501 (c)( 3 ) i javna dobrotvorna organizacija klasificirana pod IRC odjelcima 170 (b)( 1 )(A) i 509 (a)( 1 ). Bitcoin donacije koje Mozilla prima se smatraju dobrotvornim prilozima na temelju federalnih zakona SAD-a, za korištenje prema odluci za dobrotvorne svrhe. Ukoliko imate pitanja, provjerite naša česta pitanja ili nas kontaktirajte na donate@mozilla.org.

We understand that your privacy is very important. We ask for a minimum amount of information required to process credit card donations, including billing addresses. This allows our payment processor to verify your identity, process your payment, and prevent fraudulent charges to your credit card. To dopušta našem procesoru plaćanja da potvrdi vaš identitet, obradi uplatu, i spriječi prijevare. Vaše podatke držimo privatnima — ako imate pitanja, proučite našu politiku privatnosti. An ad blocker is a piece of software that can be used to block ads, and they work in two ways. The first way is when an ad blocker blocks the signal from an advertiser’s server, so the ad never shows up on your page. Another way ad blockers work is by blocking out sections of a website that could be ads.

Based on the criteria we outlined — privacy, utility, and portability — there’s really only one browser that meets the mark, and that’s Firefox. The real area of difference isn’t in functionality, it’s privacy. Firefox is the most private browser that doesn’t lock you into an ecosystem. Use it on any operating system, on all your devices, and feel secure when you do.

Here’s the key thing to know: 64-bit applications can access more memory and are less likely to crash than 32-bit applications. Also, with the jump from 32 to 64 bits, a security feature called Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) works better to protect you from attackers. Linux and macOS users, fret not, you already enjoy a Firefox that’s optimized for 64-bit.

Evo ključne stvari: 64-bitni programi mogu pristupiti većoj količini memorije i manja je vjerojatnost da će se rušiti nego 32-bitni programi. Također, sa skokom s 32 na 64 bita, sigurnosna funkcija zvana Randomizacija rasporeda adresnog prostora (ASLR) djeluje bolje kako bi te zaštitila od napadača. Korisnici Linuxa i macOS-a – ne brinite, već uživate u Firefoxu koji je optimiran za 64 bita.

Mozilla does collect a limited set of data by default from Firefox that helps us to understand how people use the browser. That data is tied to a random identifier, rather than your name or email address. You can read more about that on our privacy notice and you can read the full documentation for that data collection.

Mozilla standardno prikuplja ograničen skup podataka iz Firefoxa, koji nam pomažu razumijeti kako ljudi koriste preglednik. Podaci se povezuju sa slučajno stvorenim identifikatorom, a ne s tvojim imenom ili e-adresom. Više o tome možeš pročitati u našoj obavijesti o privatnosti ili pročitaj cjelokupnu dokumentaciju za prikupljanje tih podataka.

Mozilla doesn’t just value your email privacy and security – it’s part of our Manifesto: “Individuals’ security and privacy on the internet are fundamental and must not be treated as optional.” You can learn about our Data Privacy Principles here.

Mozilla ne cijeni samo privatnost i sigurnost e-pošte – to je dio našeg Manifesta: „Sigurnost i privatnost pojedinaca na internetu su od temeljne važnosti i ne smiju se tretirati kao opcionalne.” O našim načelima privatnosti podataka možeš saznati ovdje.
Mozilla is an open source project with a mission to improve your Internet experience. This is a driving force behind our privacy practices.
Mozilla je projekt otvorenog koda, s misijom, da poboljšamo tvoje internetsko iskustvo. To je osnova za sve što radimo po pitanju privatnosti.
Mozilla is the not-for-profit behind Firefox, the original alternative browser. We create products and policy to keep the internet in service of people, not profit.
Mozilla je neprofitna matična organizacija Firefoxa, stvarnog alternativnog preglednika. Stvaramo proizvode koji služe ljudima, a ne profitu.

Mozilla makes browsers, apps, code and tools that put people before profit. Our mission: Keep the internet open and accessible to all.

Multi-tasking with multiple tabs just got easier. Firefox is now a multi-process browser, which means that your tabs stay fresh and won’t take forever to reload. With 86% less hang time, switch quickly between tabs even as you open more.

Multitasking s više kartica je još lakši. Firefox je sada višeprocesni preglednik, što znači da će tvoje kartice ostati svježe i učitavanje neće vječno trajati. S 86 % kraćim učitavanjem, možeš se brzo prebacivati između kartica, čak i kad otvoriš daljnje kartice.
My favorite part of being a Mozillian is the global community. I like to think of us as a “family” where we accept each other openly and are free to speak our minds while we work together.
Najbolja stvar kod Mozillianera je globalna zajednica. Volim misliti o nama kao o „obitelji”, gdje jedni druge otvoreno prihvaćamo i gdje slobodno razmijenjujemo naše misli, dok radimo zajedno.
My goal now is to keep growing our global community through localization (translation), hacking and Webmaker projects. If you’re interested, please get in touch.
Moj sadašnji cilj je nastaviti razvijati našu globalnu zajednicu putem lokalizacije (prevođenja), hakiranja i webmaker projekata. Ako te to zanima, javi se.

Nightly is an unstable testing and development platform. By default, Nightly sends data to Mozilla — and sometimes our partners — to help us handle problems and try ideas. Learn what is shared.

Nightly je nestabilna platforma za testiranje i razvoj. Standardno je postavljeno, da Nightly šalje podatke Mozilli – i ponekad našim partnerima – kako bi nam pomoglo brže riješiti probleme i isprobati ideje. Saznaj koji se podaci dijele.

No more “try again” while you’re trying to get somewhere. Log in to your Firefox Account on your phone, and your passwords come with you. Your login details will simply appear, just like that.
Nema više „pokušaj ponovo” dok pokušavaš nekamo doći. Prijavi se na svoj Firefox račun na svom mobitelu i tvoje lozinke idu s tobom. Detalji tvoje prijave će se pojaviti sami od sebe.
No one likes a computer hog! Firefox is a lean, mean (actually we’re pretty nice) browsing machine. Since we use less RAM than Chrome, your other programs can keep running at top speed.

Nitko ne voli programe koji misle da je računalo u potpunosti njihovo! Firefox je brz i jednostavan preglednik. Budući da koristi manje RAM nego Chrome, drugi programi će moći istovremeno raditi s punim brzinama.

Not only do trackers collect info, they can weigh down your browsing speeds. Only Firefox Private Browsing blocks ads with hidden trackers, so you can drop the baggage and browse freely.

Programi za praćenje ne skupljaju samo informacije, nego i usporavaju brzinu pregledavanja. Samo Firefoxovo privatno pregledavanje blokira oglase koji sadrže skrivene programe za praćenje, tako da možeš pregledavati web ugodnije i brže.

Using a browser that blocks third-party trackers isn’t just important for privacy — it usually means it runs much faster, too. Most trackers are just scripts that run in the background on a number of websites. You can’t see them, but you can feel them slowing down your browser. As of version 67 of Firefox, fingerprinting and cryptominers are also blocked. If you’re not familiar with cryptominers, here’s an example of how they can affect you: maybe you’ve experienced your computer suddenly running hotter or the battery depleting faster than normal. That’s often the byproduct of cryptominers creeping around on your device.

Definition: L10n coverage is a measure of the percentage of our visitor base that get served with KB articles in their own language. It's calculated by taking into account the English top 50 weighted by the localization status of an article and the the number of visits for each locale.

Mozilla support is fully powered by our volunteer community that is helping hundreds of users everyday. This community is formed by passionate Firefox and Thunderbird users who take some of their spare time to help others. We couldn't do it without your passion and enthusiasm. Your contribution, as minor as it might seem, has tremendous value. Solving one issue in the support forums can help up to 1000 users a day!

Mozilla podršku u potpunosti pokreće naša zajednica dobrovoljaca koja svakodnevno pomaže stotinama korisnika. Zajednicu čine strastveni korisnici Firefoxa i Thunderbirda koji si uzmu malo svog slobodnog vremena kako bi pomogli drugima. Ne bismo mogli to učiniti bez njihove strasti i entuzijazma. Tvoj doprinos, koliko god ti se čini mali, ima ogromnu vrijednost. Rješavanje jednog problema na forumima za podršku može pomoći do tisuću korisnika dnevno!

{ $command } <status message>: set the status to { $status } with an optional status message.
{ $command } <statusna poruka>: postavite status na { $status } sa statusnom porukom po izboru.
{ $commandName }: Display a list of chat rooms on the network. Warning, some servers may disconnect you upon doing this.
{ $commandName }: Prikazuje popis soba za razgovor na mreži. Upozorenje, neki poslužitelji vas mogu isključiti nakon ove naredbe.
{ $commandName }: Displays the current local time at the IRC server.
{ $commandName }: Prikazuje trenutno lokalno vrijeme IRC poslužitelja.
{ $commandName } [<channel>] [(+|-)<new mode> [<parameter>][,<parameter>]*]: Get, set, or unset a channel mode.
{ $commandName } [<kanal>] [(+|-)<novi način> [<parametar>][,<parametar>]*]: Dohvaća, postavlja ili uklanja način kanala.
{ $commandName } <command>: Send a raw command to the server.
{ $commandName } <jid>[<message>]: Invite a user to join the current room with an optional message.
{ $commandName } <jid>[<poruka>]: Pozovite korisnika u trenutnu sobu s mogućom porukom.
{ $commandName } <message>: Disconnect from the server, with an optional message.
{ $commandName } <poruka>: Odjavljuje s poslužitelja, s mogućom porukom.
{ $commandName } [<message>]: Leave the current room with an optional message.
{ $commandName } [<poruka>]: Napuštanje trenutne sobe s mogućom porukom.
{ $commandName } (+|-)<new mode>: Set or unset a user mode.
{ $commandName } (+|-)<novi način>: Postavlja ili uklanja način korisnika.
{ $commandName } [<nova tema>]: Prikazuje ili mijenja temu kanala.
{ $commandName } <nick1>[,<nick2>]*: Grant channel operator status to someone. You must be a channel operator to do this.
{ $commandName } <nadimak1>[,<nadimak2>]*: Dodjeljuje status rukovoditelja kanala nekome. Morate biti rukovoditelj kanala kako biste ovo uradili.
{ $commandName } <nick1>[,<nick2>]*: Grant channel voice status to someone. You must be a channel operator to do this.
{ $commandName } <nadimak1>[,<nadimak2>]*: Daje glasovni status kanala nekome. Morate biti rukovoditelj kanala kako biste ovo uradili.
{ $commandName } <nick1>[,<nick2>]*: Remove channel operator status from someone. You must be a channel operator to do this.
{ $commandName } <nadimak1>[,<nadimak2>]*: Uklanja status rukovodioca kanala nekome. Morate biti rukovoditelj kanala kako biste ovo uradili.
{ $commandName } <nick1>[,<nick2>]*: Remove channel voice status from someone, preventing them from speaking if the channel is moderated (+m). You must be a channel operator to do this.
{ $commandName } <nadimak1>[,<nadimak2>]*: Uklanja glasovni status nekome, spriječava ga da priča ukoliko je kanal moderiran (+m). Morate biti rukovoditelj kanala kako biste ovo uradili.
{ $commandName } [<nick>]: Asks how much lag a user (or the server if no user specified) has.
{ $commandName } [<nadimak>]: Šalje upit koliko kašnjenje ima korisnik (ili poslužitelj, ako nije određen korisnik).
{ $commandName } <nick>[<message>]: Ban someone from the room. You must be a room administrator to do this.
{ $commandName } <nadimak>[<poruka>]: Zabranite nekome pristup u sobu. Morate biti admistrator sobe kako biste mogli ovo napraviti.
{ $commandName } <nick> [<message>]: Remove someone from a channel. You must be a channel operator to do this.
{ $commandName } <nadimak> [<poruka>]: Uklanja nekoga iz kanala. Morate biti rukovoditelj kanala kako biste ovo uradili.
{ $commandName } <nick>[<message>]: Remove someone from the room. You must be a room moderator to do this.
{ $commandName } <nadimak>[<poruka>]: Uklonite nekoga iz sobe. Morate biti moderator sobe kako biste mogli ovo napraviti.
{ $commandName } <nick> <message>: Send a private message to a participant in the room.
{ $commandName } <nadimak> <poruka>: Pošaljite privatnu poruku sudioniku u sobi.
{ $commandName } <nick> <message>: Send a private message to a user (as opposed to a channel).
{ $commandName } <nadimak> <poruka>: Šalje privatnu poruku korisniku (za razliku od kanala).
{ $commandName } <nick> [(+|-)<mode>]: Get, set or unset a user's mode.
{ $commandName } <nadimak> [(+|-)<način>]: Dohvaća, postavlja ili uklanja stanje korisnika.
{ $commandName } <nick> <msg>: Sends a CTCP message to the nick.
{ $commandName } <nick>[ <nick>]* [<channel>]: Invite one or more nicks to join you in the current channel, or to join the specified channel.
{ $commandName } <nadimak>[ <nadimak>]* [<kanal>]: Pozovite jedan ili više nadimaka da se prijave u vaš trenutni kanal, ili da se prijave u određeni kanal.
{ $commandName } <nick>: Request the version of a user's client.
{ $commandName } <nick!user@host>: Ban the users matching the given pattern.
{ $commandName } <nadimak!korisnik@poslužitelj>: Zabranite pristup korisnicima koji odgovaraju danom uzorku.
{ $commandName } <room1>[ <key1>][,<room2>[ <key2>]]*: Enter one or more channels, optionally providing a channel key for each if needed.
{ $commandName } <soba1>[ <ključ1>][,<soba2>[ <ključ2>]]*: Prijavljuje na jedan ili više kanala, s mogućnošću dodavanja ključa za svaki kanal ukoliko je potrebno.
{ $commandName } [<room>[@<server>][/<nick>]] [<password>]: Join a room, optionally providing a different server, or nickname, or the room password.
{ $commandName } [<soba>[@<poslužitelj>][/<nadimak>]] [<lozinka>]: Prijavite se u sobu, možete dodati drugi poslužitelj, ili nadimak, ili lozinku za sobu.
{ $commandName } <room jid>[<password>]: Invite your conversation partner to join a room, together with its password if required.
{ $commandName } <jid sobe>[<lozinka>]: Pozovite vašeg partnera za razgovor da se pridruži u sobu, zajedno s lozinkom ukoliko je potrebna.
{ $commandName } <target> <message>: Send a notice to a user or channel.
{ $commandName } [message]: Leave the current channel with an optional message.
{ $commandName } [poruka]: Napuštanje trenutnog kanala s mogućom porukom.
{ $commandName }: Request information about the client your conversation partner is using.
{ $commandName }: Zatraži informacije o programu koji vaš partner za razgovor koristi.

Accomplishing that mission means keeping Thunderbird secure, maintaining complex server infrastructure, updating old code, fixing bugs, and developing new features. These activities are expensive - requiring talented software engineers and robust infrastructure.

At the heart of Thunderbird is an open source development process driven by thousands of passionate, experienced developers and security experts spread all over the world. Our openness and active community of experts helps to ensure our products are more secure and quickly updated, while also enabling us to take advantage of the best third party security scanning and evaluation tools to further bolster overall security.

U srcu Thunderbirda nalazi se razvojni proces otvorenog kôda kojeg pokreću stotine strastvenih i iskusnih razvijatelja, te sigurnosnih stručnjaka iz cijeloga svijeta. Naša otvorenost i aktivna zajednica stručnjaka pomaže nam osigurati izdavanje sigurnih i redovito ažuriranih proizvoda, dok nam istovremeno nudi prednost korištenja najboljih alata za skeniranje i procjenu sigurnosti za dodatno ojačavanje cjelokupne sigurnosti.

Email has been and continues to be the fundamental communication tool and a significant driver of freedoms on the Internet. But it is also threatened by new non-standards-based, closed and centralized messaging platforms. To prevent this erosion, the public deserves an alternative that is secure and reliable, while protecting our privacy, enhancing our productivity and serving as a platform for current and future forms of messaging.

E-pošta je bila i nastavlja biti temeljni komunikacijski alat i značajan pokretač slobodna na Internetu. Ali je također i pod prijetnjom od strane novih ne standardnih, zatvorenih i centraliziranih platformi. Kako bi spriječili eroziju, javnost zaslužuje alternativu koja je sigurna i pouzdana, istovremeno štiteći našu privatnost, povećavajući našu produktivnost i služeći kao platforma za trenutne i buduće oblike slanja poruka.

End-to-end encryption for email can be used to ensure that only the sender and the recipients of a message can read the contents. Without this protection it is easy for email providers and mass surveillance to read your messages. If you would like to learn more about how end-to-end encryption in Thunderbird works, check out our article: Introduction to End-to-end encryption in Thunderbird.

Kriptiranje od-kraja-do-kraja za e-poštu se može koristiti kako bi osigurali da samo pošiljatelj i primatelj poruke mogu pročitati njen sadržaj. Bez ove zaštite pružateljima usluga e-pošte ili državnim agencijama je jednostavno pročitati vaše poruke. Ukoliko želite saznati više o tome kako kriptiranje u Thunderbirdu radi, pročitajte naš članak: Uvod u Thunderbird kriptiranje od-kraja-do-kraja.

Enjoy real-time conversation with your contacts, right from your favorite messaging application, with multiple supported networks. Thunderbird makes it easy to search through both past conversations and received emails.

Gifts to Thunderbird are not tax-deductible as charitable gifts, but are greatly appreciated. Giving to Thunderbird supports the development of our leading open source cross-platform email and calendaring client, free for business and personal use. Your gift will help ensure it stays that way, and will support future development.

Vaš će dar pomoći da tako i ostane, te će podržat će budući razvoj.

Managing multiple calendars has been made easier with the calendar sidebar improvements in this release. There is a quick enable button for disabled calendars, a lock indicator for read-only calendars, and a show/hide icon for easily toggling what calendars are visible. Outside the sidebar, there are now better color accents to highlight the current day in the calendar.

Upravljanje s više kalendara je olakšano unaprijeđenjem bočne trake u ovom izdanju. Dodana je tipka za brzo omogućavanje onemogućenih kalendara, indikator zaključanih kalendara, i tipka za prikaz/skrivanje za jednostavno uključivanje vidljivosti kalendara. One-click Address Book is a quick and easy way to add people to your address book. Add people by simply clicking on the star icon in the message you receive. Two clicks and you can add more details like a photo, birthday, and other contact information.

Jednim klikom do adresara, moguće je brzo i jednostavno dodati osobe u vlastiti adresar. Dodaj osobe klikom na zvjezdicu u zaprimljenoj poruci. Ako klikneš dvaput, moći ćeš dodati daljnje podatke, poput slike, datum rođenja i sl.

One of the most noticeable changes for Thunderbird 91 is the new account setup wizard. The new wizard not only features a better look, but does auto-discovery of calendars and address books and allows most users to set them up with just a click. After setting up an account, the wizard also points users at additional (optional) things to do – such as adding a signature or setting up end-to-end encryption.

Jedna on najuočljivijih novosti u Thunderbirdu 91 je novi čarobnjak za postavljanje računa. Novi čarobnjak ne samo da bolje izgleda, nego također omogućuje automatsko postavljanje kalendara i adresara za većinu korisnika samo jednim klikom. Nakon postavljanja računa, čarobnjak usmjerava korisnike na dodatne (neobavezne) postavke – kao što je dodavanje potpisa ili postavljanje kriptiranja poruka.

Simply install beta over top of your current program directory, using the default installer choices. Beta will then <u>use your current (production) default profile</u>. Because it uses your default profile, this choice makes it more difficult to switch back to using a release version should you wish to do so in the future. In other words, you should not switch back and forth between beta and normal release using the same profile.

Jednostavno instalirajte beta inačicu preko postojeće inačice, koristeći zadane odabire prilikom instalacije. Beta će tada <u>koristiti postojeće (produkcijske) zadane profile</u>. Iz razloga što koristi već postojeće profile, ovaj način instalacije čini težim povratak nazad na stabilnu inačicu ukoliko tako odlučite. Drugim riječima, ne biste trebali skakati između beta i stabilnih inačica koristeći postojeći profil.

Stoga vas danas molimo da nam pomognete. Ako imate koristi od korištenja Thunderbirda, razmislite o davanju donacije kako biste ga podržali!
Thunderbird is funded by users like you! If you like Thunderbird, please consider making a donation. The best way for you to ensure Thunderbird remains available is to make a donation.
Thunderbird je financiran od strane korisnika kao što ste i ti! Ukoliko ti se sviđa Thunderbird, razmisli o doniranju. Najbolji način da osiguraš dostupnost Thunderbirda u budućnosti je donacija.
Thunderbird’s mission is to offer a time and privacy-respecting, customizable communication experience that gives you control of your data and experience. Free to everyone!
Thunderbird misija je ponuditi komunikacijsko iskustvo koje je poštuje vaše vrijeme i privatnost, te vam daje kontrolu nad vašim podacima i iskustvima. Besplatan za sve!
Without you, Thunderbird can’t exist. Giving a gift today means Thunderbird continues to remain available!
Bez vas Thunderbird ne može postojati. Ako darujete danas, Thunderbird će i dalje biti dostupan!
Supernova continues to iterate on the modernized Address Book introduced in Thunderbird 102. You’ll enjoy a new tabular view, an improved Edit view, delete buttons, and better accessibility.
Supernova nastavlja moderniziranje adresara predstavljenog u Thunderbird 102. Uživati ćete u novom tabličnom prikazu, poboljšanom prikazu uređivanja, tipkama za brisanje i boljoj pristupačnosti.

Supernova features a single dynamic toolbar, presenting frequently used and contextual options based on the tab or Space that is currently active. Take full control by customizing the toolbar and window layout to perfectly fit your workflow.

Supernova posjeduje jedinstvenu dinamičnu alatnu traku, koja prikazuje često korištene mogućnosti na temelju konteksta trenutno otvorene kartice ili aktivnog prostora. Preuzmite potpunu kontrolu prilagođavajući alatnu traku i prozore kako bi savršeno odgovarali vašem tijeku rada.

Supernova gives you more control by introducing sortable Folder Modes. Display all of your Tags in the Folder Pane, turn on and off Local Folders, or move your favorite Folder Mode sections up and down with one click. Less scrolling, more productivity.

Supernova vam daje više kontrole uvođenjem načina rada mapa u kojem se mogu razvrstati. Prikažite sve svoje oznake u oknu mapa, uključite ili isključite lokalne mape ili premjestite omiljeni odabir načina mapa prema gore ili prema dolje sa jednim klikom. Manje pomicanja, više produktivnosti.

Supernova is constantly evolving. Throughout the next year, we’ll deliver many improvements to existing Supernova features and introduce brand new ones. Upgrade to version 115 and experience the future of Thunderbird!

Supernova se konstantno razvija. Tijekom sljedeće godine isporučiti ćemo mnoga poboljšanja postojećih Supernova mogućnosti i predstaviti neke nove. Ažurirajte na inačicu 115 i doživite budućnost Thunderbirda!

Supernova’s new Card View is our version of the well-known vertical layout for the Message List, perfect for people used to modern webmail. Card View emulates a mobile interface list with multi-line support, offering a more comfortable appearance to reduce cognitive burden.

Supernova novi prikaz kartica je naša inačica dobro poznatog okomitog prikaza popisa poruka, savršenog za korisnike koji su navikli na moderne web inačice e-pošte. Prikaz kartica simulira mobilno sučelje sa višelinijskom podrškom, nudeći ugodniji izgled uz smanjenje kognitivnog opterećenja.

Supernova substantially improves Thunderbird’s keyboard navigation and screen reader accessibility across the entire application. We’ve also greatly expanded the ability to navigate Mail content and buttons using the TAB and arrow keys.

Supernova stalno poboljšava Thunderbird navigaciju pomoću tipkovnice i pristupačnost čitačima zaslona diljem aplikacije. Znatno smo proširili mogućnost navigacije sadržajem poruke i tipkama koristeći TAB tipku i strelice.

Tags are a familiar and powerful part of your workflow, so Supernova adds an eye-catching “Tags” view to the Folder Pane. Quickly jump to your custom, color-coded tag categories to find and filter your messages even faster.

Oznake su poznati i moćni dio vašeg načina rada, tako da smo u Supernovi dodali privlačni prikaz oznaka u okno mapa. Brzo prijeđite na svoje prilagođene, bojom označene kategorije kako biste pronašli i filtrirali poruke još brže.
Thank you for contacting us. A case has been created for your issue and we will be in touch shortly.
Hvala što ste nas kontaktirali. Otvoren je slučaj za vaš problem i uskoro ćemo vas kontaktirati.
Thank you for downloading and installing Thunderbird!
Hvala vam što ste preuzeli i instalirali Thunderbird!

Thank you for supporting Thunderbird, which is funded by users like you! Producing Thunderbird requires software engineers, designers, system administrators and server infrastructure. So if you like Thunderbird, the best way to ensure Thunderbird remains available is to make a donation.

Hvala vam što podržavate Thunderbird, koji financiraju korisnici poput vas! Za proizvodnju Thunderbirda potrebni su softverski inženjeri, dizajneri, administratori sustava i poslužiteljska infrastruktura. Dakle, ako vam se sviđa Thunderbird, najbolji način da osigurate da Thunderbird ostane dostupan je da donirate.

Thank you for using Thunderbird Beta. Your experiences with beta are important, so please report rough edges, bugs, and provide feedback in the ways suggested below - to help make the next Thunderbird release as awesome as possible.

Hvala što koristite Thunderbird Beta. Vaša iskustva s beta inačicom su važna, pa vas molimo da prijavite greške i pružite povratne informacije na dolje predložene načine - kako biste pomogli da sljedeće izdanje Thunderbirda bude što je moguće bolje.

The Account Setup window and the Account Central tab have both been updated. The Account Central tab appears when you do not have an account setup, or when you select an existing account in the folder tree.
Ažurirani su prozor za postavljanje računa i kartica računa. Kartica računa se pojavljuje se kada nemate postavljen računa ili kada odaberete postojeći račun u stablu mapa.

The Activity Manager records all the interactions between Thunderbird and your email provider in one place. There’s no more guess work. You only have to look in one place to see everything that’s happening with your email.

Upravljač aktivnosti bilježi sve interakcije između Thunderbirda i vašeg pružatelja usluge e-pošte. Da biste saznali što se događa s vašom e-poštom više ne trebate razbijati glavu, sve su informacije dostupne na jednom mjestu.
The attachment reminder looks for the word attachment (and other words like file types) in the body of your message and reminds you to add an attachment before hitting send.
Dok pišeš poruku, podsjetnik privitaka traži riječ privitak (i riječi poput vrste datoteka) i podsjeća te dodati privitak prije slanja poruke.

The attachments pane has been moved to the bottom of the compose window for better visibility of filenames as well as being able to see many at once. We’ve also added an overlay that appears when you drag-and-drop a file into the compose window asking how you would like to handle the file in that email (such as putting a picture in-line in your message or simply attaching it to the email).

Okno privitaka je pomaknuto na dno prozora za pisanje poruka za bolju vidljivost naziva datoteka, kao i mogućnost da se vidi više datoteka odjednom. Također smo dodali sloj koji prekriva prozor za pisanje kada dovučete i ispustite datoteku koji vas pita kako želite upravljati datotekom u toj poruci e-pošte (kao što je umetanje slike u poruku ili jednostavno je imati kao privitak poruci).

The compose window has been reworked to make composing a message faster, easier and more straightforward. The compose window now also takes up less space with recipients listed in “pills” instead of an entire line for each address.

Prozor za pisanje je ponovno napravljen kako bi se ubrzalo pisanje poruke, olakšalo i učinilo jednostavnijim. Prozor za pisanje sada zauzima manje prostora zbog popisa primatelja u “pilulama” umjesto da zauzimaju cijelu liniju za svaku adresu.
The dark theme available in Thunderbird has been enhanced with a dark message thread pane as well as many other small improvements.
Tamni motiv u Thunderbirdu poboljšan je s tamnim prozorom za poruke, kao i mnogim drugim malim poboljšanjima.
The improved address book edit pane

The layout and dialogues have been improved to make it easier to understand the information displayed and to find relevant settings. The Account Central tab also has new information about the Thunderbird project and displays the version you are using.

Izgled i dijalozi su poboljšani kako bi bilo lakše razumjeti prikazane informacije i kako bi istaknuli bitne postavke. Kartica računa također ima nove informacije o Thunderbird projektu i prikazuje trenutnu inačicu koju koristiti.

Themes allow you to change the look of Thunderbird in an instant. Working on getting to inbox zero at night? Turn on the dark theme to make managing your email easier on the eyes. Thunderbird ships with both light and dark themes, and more are available as add-ons.
Motivi omogućuju trenutnu promjenu izgleda Thunderbirda. Radiš noću? Ne napreži oči – uključi tamni motiv. Thunderbird sadrži svijetli i tamni motiv, a mnogi drugi su dostupni kao dodaci.

The new Application Menu (≡) in Supernova is now keyboard-accessible, and redesigned for faster, easier navigation. Fewer submenus, persistent global options, and consistent iconography combine to create a much more intuitive experience.

Novi izbornik aplikacije (≡) u Supernovi sada je dostupan putem tipkovničkih kratica i redizajniran za bržu i jednostavniju navigaciju. Manje podizbornika, stalne globalne mogućnosti i standardizirana ikonografija zajedno omogućuju puno intuitivnije iskustvo.
The new Preferences tab also makes it easier to multi-task without the problem of losing track of where your preferences are when switching between windows.
Nova kartica postavki također olakšava obavljanje višestrukih zadataka bez zaboravljanja tvojih postavki prilikom prebacivanja između prozora.
The page you are looking for doesn’t exist.

The page you are looking for doesn’t exist.
If you think this is a bug, you can report an issue here.

Stranica koju tražiš ne postoji.
Ako misliš da je ovo greška, možeš prijaviti grešku ovdje.
The page you are looking for doesn’t exist. If you think this is a bug, you can report an issue here.
Stranica koju ste tražili ne postoji. Ukoliko mislite da je ovo greška, možete prijaviti grešku ovdje.

The Quick Filter Toolbar lets you filter your email faster. Start typing in words in the Quick Filter search box and the results are displayed instantly. Or you can filter your email by New Messages, Tags, and people in your Address Book. You can also "Pin" or save a Filter and use it across multiple folders.

Traka brzog filtriranja omogućava još brže filtriranje poruka. Počni pisati pojam u polje brzog filtriranja i rezultati će se odmah prikazati. Svoje poruke također možeš filtrirati prema datumu, oznakama i kontaktima iz tvog adresara. Filtre možeš i "zakačiti", te ih koristiti unutar višestrukih mapa.

There are many other big changes that make Thunderbird 78 a very large release including: calendar and tasks are now integrated into Thunderbird, folder icons are now updated and their colors are customizable, the preferences are now searchable, and minimize to tray is now supported on Windows.

Postoje i mnoge druge velike izmjene koje čine Thunderbird 78 jako velikim izdanjem, a koje uključuju: kalendar i zadaci su sada integrirani u Thunderbird, ikone mapa su sada ažurirane i njihove boje su prilagodljive, postavke se sada mogu pretraživati i minimiziranje u alatnu traku je sada podržano na Windowsima.
There are many other big changes that make Thunderbird 91 a very large release including:

There are many other smaller changes that make Thunderbird 68 feel polished and powerful including: a new App Menu UI, an updated To/CC/BCC selector in compose, improved attachment management, full color support across the app, filters can now be set to run periodically, and feed articles now show external attachments as links.

Postoje mnoge druge male izmjene koje čine Thunderbird 68 boljim i moćnijim: novo sučelje izbornika aplikacije, nadograđeni Prima/CC/BCC odabir prilikom pisanja poruke, poboljšano upravljanje privicima, podrška punoj paleti boja diljem aplikacije, filteri se sada mogu narediti na povremeno pokretanje i članci preuzeti putem kanala sada prikazuju vanjske privitke kao poveznice.
There are many other updates in this release, you can see a list of all of them in the Thunderbird 68 release notes.
Postoje mnoga druga ažuriranja u ovoj verziji, možeš provjeriti popis svih u napomenama o izdanju Thunderbird 68.
The redesigned compose window makes it easier to manage many email recipients, and the new intuitive layout helps users to discover its features.
Redizajnirani prozor za pisanje olakšava upravljanje s mnogo primatelja i novi intuitivni izgled olakšava korisnicima otkrivanje novih mogućnosti.

There is a passionate team of volunteers involved in developing Thunderbird and assisting its users who would welcome your involvement. Check out our Get Involved page to learn how you can participate on the Thunderbird team. We also have paid staff working full-time on Thunderbird, funded by donations from our users. If you’re curious about who is working on Thunderbird, check out the list of our core contributors.

Postoji strastveni tim volontera koji sudjeluju u razvoju Thunderbirda i pomaganju korisnicima, a koji će pozdraviti tvoju odluku o sudjelovanju. Pogledaj našu stranicu Uključi se i saznaj mugućnosti sudjelovanja u Thunderbird timu. There is now a dark mode in Thunderbird, making late-night email easier on the eyes. To enable, Thunderbird will use your operating system settings to see if you have enabled dark mode OS-wide.

Sada postoji tamni način rada u Thunderbirdu, što olakšava čitanje e-pošte noću. Thunderbird će automatski koristiti postavke vašeg operativnog sustava ukoliko ste omogućili tamni način rada za cijeli OS.

The search interface in Thunderbird contains filtering and timeline tools to pinpoint the exact email you’re looking for. Thunderbird also indexes all of your emails and chat conversations to help you search even faster. Your search results are displayed in a tab so you can easily switch back and forth to your search results and other email.

Sučelje pretraživanja sadrži alate za filtriranje i kronološko sortiranje za pronalaženje upravo one poruke koju tražiš. Thunderbird također indeksira sve tvoje poruke i razgovore kako bi pretraživanje poruka učinio još bržim. Rezultati pretraživanja se prikazuju u zasebnoj kartici, stoga se možeš jednostavnije prebacivati između rezultata pretraživanja i ostalih poruka.

Your search results are displayed in a tab so you can easily switch back and forth to your search results and other email.

Sučelje pretraživanja sadrži alate za filtriranje i kronološko sortiranje kako biste pronašli upravo onu poruku koju tražite. Thunderbird također indeksira sve vaše poruke kako bi pretraživanje poruka učinio još bržim. Ovo su službene inačice održavane i distribuirane od strane Thunderbirda.

Ovo su službene inačice održavane i distribuirane od strane Thunderbirda. Preuzmite najnoviju stabilnu inačicu osim ako ne želite testirati Beta inačicu i prijavljivati greške.
The submit button will be disabled until you complete the CAPTCHA.
Tipka za slanje bit će onemogućena dok ne dovršite CAPTCHA.

The Thunderbird project is governed by seven councilors, elected by the Thunderbird community’s active contributors. You can see the current elected Thunderbird Council members on the Thunderbird wiki.

Thunderbird projektom upravljaju sedam vijećnika, izabranih od strane aktivnih suradnika Thunderbird zajednice. Možeš vidjeti trenutačno izabrane članove Thunderbird Vijeća na Thunderbird wiki stranici.
Think you’ve found a new problem or rough edge? Create a bug report so we can make sure it gets solved, resulting in a better Thunderbird experience for all.
Mislite da ste pronašli novu grešku? Napravite izvješće o pogrešci kako bismo bili sigurni da će biti riješena, što će rezultirati boljim Thunderbird iskustvom za sve.
Think you’ve found a problem with Thunderbird? Create a bug report so that we can make sure it gets solved. Helping us identify and fix bugs makes for a better Thunderbird for all.
Misliš da postoji greška u Thunderbirdu? Prijavi grešku kako bismo je mogli ispraviti. Pomaganjem da indentificiramo i popravimo greške činimo Thunderbird boljim za sve.
This article describes some of the major changes visible to users in Thunderbird version 68.0. Full details of all the changes can be found in the Thunderbird 68 release notes.
Ovaj članak opisuje neke od velikih izmjena koje su vidljive korisnicima u Thunderbird verziji 68.0. Potpuni popis izmjena može se pronaći u napomenama o izdanju Thunderbird 68.
This article describes some of the major changes visible to users in Thunderbird version 78. Full details of all the changes can be found in the Thunderbird release notes from 78.0 and up.
Ovaj članak opisuje neke od velikih izmjena koje su vidljive korisnicima u Thunderbird inačici 78. Potpuni popis izmjena može se pronaći u napomenama o izdanju Thunderbird 78 i novijim.

Ovaj članak opisuje neke od velikih izmjena koje su vidljive korisnicima u Thunderbird inačici 91. Potpuni popis izmjena može se pronaći u napomenama o izdanju Thunderbird 91.0 i novijim.

Ovaj izbor ima prednost da forsira zaseban profil za svaku Thunderbird inačicu što vam omogućuje da imate stabilnu i beta inačicu odjadnom na računalu. Tako da možete:

Thunderbird 102 and newer on Windows will install beta into its own program directory. For older versions on Windows consult the beta support article. For other operating systems use an install method appropriate for your OS to target a uniquely named directory.

Thunderbird 102 i noviji na Windowsima će instalirati betu u poseban direktorij. Za starije Windows inačice posjetite članak beta podrške. Za druge operativne sustave koristite prikladnu metodu kako biste instalirati u zaseban direktorij.
[Thunderbird] empowers me to maintain ownership of my emails.
[Thunderbird] mi omogućuje da zadržim vlasništvo nad svojom e-poštom.

Thunderbird facilitates cross platform, decentralized, open-standard communication, which puts the user in control of their data and workflow. We aspire to offer an interoperable and extensible open-source platform for messaging and managing personal information, such as email, contacts, and appointments.

Thunderbird omogućuje međuplatformske, decentralizirane, otvorene standarde komunikacije, koja korisniku daje kontrolu nad svojim podacima i tijekom rada. Težimo ponuditi interoperabilanu i proširivu platformu otvorenog koda za slanje poruka i upravljanje osobnim podacima, kao što su e-pošta, kontakti i sastanci.

Thunderbird is a free and open source email, newsfeed, chat, and calendaring client, that’s easy to set up and customize. One of the core principles of Thunderbird is the use and promotion of open standards - this focus is a rejection of our world of closed platforms and services that can’t communicate with each other. We want our users to have freedom and choice in how they communicate.

Thunderbird je besplatan i otvoren program za e-poštu, interesne grupe, čavrljanje i kalendare, koji je jednostavan za postaviti i prilagoditi. Jedno od temeljnih načela Thunderbirda je korištenje i promocija otvorenih standarda - razlog ovog fokusa je odbijanje našeg svijeta da koristi platforme koje su zatvorene i usluge koje ne mogu komunicirati jedna s drugom. Želimo da naši korisnici imaju slobodu i izbor kako žele komunicirati.

Thunderbird is a free and open-source software project founded in 2003 to make communicating and collaborating better. We are supported by the talent and donations of thousands of generous individuals and are backed by Mozilla. Essential values guide us and make our work relevant. Read further to learn more.

Thunderbird besplatni projekt otvorenog koda osnovan 2003 godine kako bi učinio komunikaciju i suradnju boljom. Podržani samo talentom i donacijama tisuće velikodušnih pojedinaca, a podržava nas i Mozilla. Bitne vrijednosti nas vode i čine naš rad relevantnim. Čitajte dalje kako biste saznali više.
Thunderbird is a free email application that’s easy to set up and customize - and it’s loaded with great features!
Thunderbird je besplatan program za e-poštu, jednostavno se podešava i prilagođava, a ima i brdo sjajnih funkcija!
Thunderbird is a free email application that’s easy to set up and customize - and it’s loaded with great features!
Thunderbird je besplatan klijent e-pošte koji se jednostavno podešava i prilagođava, a ima i brdo sjajnih mogućnosti!

Thunderbird is an independent project with its legal and financial home at the Mozilla Foundation. The Mozilla Foundation believes the Internet is a global public resource that must remain open and accessible to all. It is focused on advocacy issues and keeping the Internet healthy, but is also the sole shareholder in the maker of Firefox, the Mozilla Corporation. Mozilla exerts no governance over the project, which instead falls to the Thunderbird Council, elected by the Thunderbird project’s community. The Mozilla Foundation became Thunderbird’s home after an exploration of legal homes in 2017.

Thunderbird je neovisan projekt s odvojenim pravnim i financijskim dijelom pod kapom Mozilla fundacije. Mozilla fundacija vjeruje da je internet globalni javni resurs koji mora ostati otvoren i dostupan svima. Usmjerena je na zaštitu i održavanje Interneta zdravim, ali je i jedini dioničar u proizvođaču Firefoxa, Mozilla Corporation. Mozilla ne upravlja Thunderbird projektom, nego upravljanje vodi Thunderbird vijeće, izabrano od strane Thunderbird zajednice. Mozilla fundacija je postala dom Thunderbirda nakon istraživanja pravnih subjekata u 2017. godini.
Thunderbird is an open source project, which means anyone can contribute ideas, designs, code, and time helping fellow users.
Thunderbird je projekt otvorenog koda, što znači da svatko može doprinijeti idejama, dizajnom, programiranjem i vremenom tako da pomogne kolegama korisnicima.

Thunderbird is an open source project, which means anyone can contribute ideas, designs, code, and time helping fellow users. Become part of a team that supports Thunderbird users, and makes Thunderbird awesome. Join us

Thunderbird je projekt otvorenog koda, što znači da svatko može doprinjeti idejama, programiranjem i vremenom. Postani dio tima koji podržava Thunderbird korisnike i pomogni stvoriti savršen Thunderbird. Pridruži nam se
Thunderbird is a project of MZLA Technologies Corporation, which is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mozilla Foundation.
Thunderbird je projekt MZLA Technologies Corporation, koja je podružnica u potpunom vlasništvu Mozilla Foundation.
Thunderbird is both free and freedom respecting, but we’re also completely funded by donations! Help us sustain the project and continue to improve.
Thunderbird je besplatan i poštuje slobodu. S druge strane, projekt se potpuno financira putem donacija! Pomogni nam održati projekt i nastaviti ga unapređivati.

Thunderbird is clean and elegant by default, but easily customizable to match your workflow and visual preferences. It is loaded with unique and powerful features. Here are just a few that people love:

Thunderbird je čist i elegantan, ali ga možete jednostavno prilagoditi kako bi odgovarao vašem tijeku rada i vizualnim preferencijama. Opremljen je jedinstvenima i moćnim mogućnostima. Evo samo nekoliko koje ljudi vole:

Thunderbird is currently transitioning to an independent organization. Being independent, we can shape our own fate, but there is significant infrastructure that must be maintained to deliver the application to our tens of millions of users. For Thunderbird to survive and continue to evolve, we need your support and ask for your donation today. All the money donated will go directly to funding Thunderbird development and infrastructure.

Thunderbird je trenutno u procesu prijelaza u nezavisnu organizaciju. Neovisni možemo samostalno oblikovati svoju sudbinu, ali postoji značajna infrastruktura koja se mora održavati kako bismo dostavili program desecima miliona korisnika. Kako bi Thunderbird opstao i nastavio napredovati, trebamo vašu podršku i donacije već danas. Sav donirani novac će ići direktno u financiranje razvoja Thunderbirda i potrebnu infrastrukturu.

Thunderbird is funded by user donations. We don’t collect personal data, sell ads in your inbox, or secretly train AI with your private conversations. Thunderbird is open source. As part of the Mozilla family you can be confident we always put your privacy and security first.

Thunderbird se financira donacijama korisnika. Ne prikupljamo osobne podatke, ne prodajemo reklame u vašoj pristigloj pošti, niti tajno treniramo UI na vašim privatnim razgovorima. Thunderbird je otvorenog koda. Kao dio Mozilla obitelji možete biti sigurni da uvijek stavljamo vašu privatnost i sigurnost na prvo mjesto.

Thunderbird is no longer funded by Mozilla. Fortunately there is an active community keeping it running and developing it further. But to survive long term, the project needs funding.
Thunderbird više ne financira Mozilla. Na sreću, postoji aktivna zajednica koja održava Thunderbird i dalje ga razvija. Ali da bi dugoročno opstao, projektu je potrebno financiranje.

Thunderbird is proud to be funded exclusively by our community, not by selling personal data or displaying ads in your inbox.
Thunderbird je ponosno financiran isključivo od strane zajednice, ne od prodaje osobnih podataka ili prikazivanja reklama na temelju vaše primljene pošte.

Thunderbird is the leading open source, cross-platform and calendaring client, free for business and personal use. We want it to stay secure and become even better. A donation will allow us to hire developers, pay for infrastructure, and continue to improve.

Thunderbird je vodeći program za e-poštu i kalendare, otvorenog koda, dostupan na više platformi, besplatan za poslovno i privatno korištenje. Želimo da ostane siguran i postane još bolji. Donacija će nam omogućiti da zaposlimo programere, platimo za infrastrukturu i nastavimo poboljšavati Thunderbird.

Thunderbird keeps getting better. Subscribe to our newsletter and follow us on social media to stay informed.

Thunderbird lives at the nonprofit Mozilla Foundation.
Thunderbird je dio neprofitne Mozilla fundacije.
Thunderbird makes email better for you, bringing together speed, privacy and the latest technologies. Focus on what matters and forget about complexity.
Thunderbird poboljšava e-poštu, donosi brzinu, privatnost i najnovije tehnologije. Usredotoči se na ono što je važno i zaboravi ostalo.

Thunderbird now has a built-in PDF viewer, which means you can read and even do some editing on PDFs sent to you as attachments. You can do all this without ever leaving Thunderbird, allowing you to return to your inbox without missing a beat.

Thunderbird sada ima ugrađen PDF preglednik, što znači da možete čitati ili čak i uređivati neke PDFove koji su vam poslani kao privitak. Ovo sve možete uraditi bez da napustite Thunderbird, što vam omogućuje brzi povratak u primljenu poštu.
Thunderbird offers support for user privacy and remote image protection. To ensure a user’s privacy, Thunderbird automatically blocks remote images in email messages.

Thunderbird nudi podršku za privatnost korisnika i zaštitu prikaza slika s udaljenih poslužitelja. Da bi osigurao privatnost korisnika, Thunderbird automatski blokira učitavanje slika s udaljenih poslužitelja koje se nalaze unutar poruke.

Thunderbird protects you from email scams which try to trick users into handing over personal and confidential information by indicating when a message is a potential phishing attempt. As a second line of defense, Thunderbird warns you when you click on a link which appears to be taking you to a different Web site than the one indicated by the URL in the message.

Thunderbird te štiti od prijevara putem e-pošte, koje te nastoje navesti da pošalješ osobne ili povjerljive informacije. Thunderbird te također upozorava kad klikneš na poveznicu koja te zapravo pokušava odvesti na drugačiju stranicu.
Thunderbird release notes are specific to each version of the application. Select your version from the list below to see the release notes for it.
Napomene o izdanju su specifične za svaku Thunderbird verziju. Za prikaz napomena, odaberi svoju verziju iz donjeg popisa.
Thunderbird release notes are specific to each version of the application. Select your version from the list below to see the release notes for it.
Napomene o izdanju su specifične za svaku Thunderbird verziju. Za prikaz napomena, odaberi svoju verziju iz donjeg popisa.

Thunderbird’s Dark Theme got even better in this release. In the past some windows and dialogues looked a bit out of place if you had Thunderbird’s dark theme selected. Now almost every dialogue and window in Thunderbird is fully styled to respect the user’s color scheme preferences.

Thunderbird tamna tema je još bolja u ovom izdanju. U prošlosti neki prozori i dijalozi su izgledali pomalo neumjesno ukoliko ste imali omogućenu tamnu temu. Sada je gotovo svaki prozor i dijalog u Thunderbirdu potpuno stiliziran kako bi poštovao korisnički odabrane sheme boje.

Thunderbird’s funding goes toward the significant infrastructure and staff that must be maintained to deliver the application to our tens of millions of users. For Thunderbird to survive and continue to evolve, we need your support and ask for your donation today. All the money donated will go directly to funding Thunderbird development and infrastructure.

Thunderbird financiranje se koristi za održavanje značajne infrastrukture i osoblja kako bismo dostavili program desecima milijuna korisnika. Kako bi Thunderbird opstao i nastavio napredovati, trebamo vašu podršku i donacije već danas. Sav donirani novac će ići direktno u financiranje razvoja Thunderbirda i potrebne infrastrukture.
Thunderbird’s mission is to give you the best privacy-respecting, customizable communication experience possible. Free for everyone to install and enjoy!
Misija Thunderbirda je dati vam najbolje moguće iskustvo korištenja uz čuvanje vaše privatnosti i veliku mogućnost prilagodbe. Besplatan za instalaciju i uživanje!

Thunderbirdʼs Options/Preferences have been converted from a dialog window to its own dedicated tab. The new Preferences tab provides more space which allows for better organized content and is more consistent with the look and feel of the rest of Thunderbird.
Thunderbird postavke su prebačene iz zasebnog prozora u svoju karticu. Nova kartica postavki pruža više prostora koji dozvoljava bolje organizirani sadržaj i više je u skladu s ostatkom Thunderbirda.

Thunderbird’s popular junk mail tools have been updated to stay ahead of spam. Each email you receive passes through Thunderbird’s leading-edge junk mail filters. Each time you mark messages as spam, Thunderbird "learns" and improves its filtering so you can spend more time reading the mail that matters. Thunderbird can also use your mail provider’s spam filters to keep junk mail out of your inbox.

Thunderbirdovi popularni alati za neželjenu poštu su ažurirani da ostaneš korak ispred neželjene pošte. Svaka poruka koju primiš prolazi kroz najnaprednije Thunderbirdove filtre protiv neželjene pošte. Svaki put kad označiš poruku kao neželjenu poštu, Thunderbird „uči” i unapređuje svoje metode filtriranja kako bi tebi u budućnosti omogućio koristiti vrijeme za čitanje bitnih poruka. Thunderbird može također koristiti filtre tvog pružatelja usluge e-pošte.

Thunderbird’s update system checks to see if you’re running the latest version, and notifies you when a security update is available. These security updates are small (usually 200KB - 700KB), giving you only what you need and making the security update quick to download and install. The automated update system provides updates for Thunderbird on Windows, macOS, and Linux in over 40 different languages.

Thunderbirdov sustav ažuriranja provjerava koristiš li najnoviju verziju i obaviještava te kad su dostupna sigurnosna ažuriranja. Ova sigurnosna ažuriranja su obično mala (oko 200 KB – 700 KB), pružaju ti samo ono što je potrebno i omogućuju brzo preuzimanje i instaliranje. Automatski sustav ažuriranja dostupan je za Thunderbird na Windows, macOS i Linux sustavima i na 40 jezika.

Thunderbirdov sustav ažuriranja provjerava koristite li najnoviju inačicu, i obaviještava vas kada su dostupna sigurnosna ažuriranja. Ova sigurnosna ažuriranja su obično mala (oko 200KB - 700KB), pružaju vam samo ono što trebate i omogućuju brzo preuzimanje i instaliranje. Automatski sustav ažuriranja je dostupan za Thunderbird na Windowsima, OS X i Linuxu i na 40 različitih jezika.

We are a community making communication free and open.
Mi smo zajednica koja čini komunikaciju slobodnom i otvorenom.

We do not collect any additional fees or taxes. When you donate in your local currency you are not charged a conversion fee by your credit card. Optionally, you can choose to cover our transaction costs on your donation. This is completely voluntary and you may opt in or out using the checkbox on our donation form. Our organization is based in the United States. We encourage donors to research any additional external taxes or fees that may be applied by regulators such as your bank or tax authority.

Ne naplaćujemo nikakve dodatne naknade ili poreze. Kada donirate u svojoj lokalnoj valuti, vaša kartica ne naplaćuje naknadu za konverziju. Po želji, možete odlučiti pokriti naše transakcijske troškove svojom donacijom. Ovo je potpuno dobrovoljno i može se uključiti ili isključiti pomoću potvrdnog okvira na našem obrascu za donacije. Naša organizacija nalazi se u SAD-u. Potičemo donatore da istraže sve dodatne vanjske poreze ili naknade koje mogu primijeniti regulatori kao što su vaša banka ili porezna uprava.
We don’t show advertisements or sell your data and we are completely funded by donations from our community.
Ne prikazujemo reklame niti prodajemo vaše podatke i u potpunosti se financiramo donacijama naše zajednice.
We don’t show advertisements or sell your data. You are not the product.
Ne prikazujemo reklame niti prodajemo vaše podatke. Vi niste proizvod.
We look forward to hearing from you.

We understand that your privacy is very important. We ask for a minimum amount of information required to process credit card payments, including billing addresses. This allows our payment processor to verify your identity, process your payment, and prevent fraudulent charges to your credit card. We keep your information private — if you have questions, please refer to our Privacy Policy. If you would rather not fill in your information on our online form, you can mail us a check.

Mi razumijemo da je vaša privatnost vrlo važna. Tražimo minimalnu količinu informacija potrebnih da obradimo donacije putem kartice, uključujući i adresu za naplatu. To dopušta našem procesoru plaćanja da potvrdi vaš identitet, obradi uplatu, i spriječi prijevare. Vaše podatke držimo privatnima — ako imate pitanja, proučite našu politiku privatnosti. Ako ne želite unijeti vaše podatke u naš obrazac za donacije, možete nam poštom poslati ček.

When quitting Thunderbird, visible tabs will be saved and will be restored when you open Thunderbird the next time. There is also a Tab menu on the Tab toolbar to help you switch between Tabs.

Pri zatvaranju Thunderbirda, zapamtit će se vidljive kartice, te će se ponovo otvoriti pri idućem pokretanja Thunderbirda. U traci kartica također postoji i izbornik kartica, koji olakšava premještanje po karticama.

When you donate via our online form, simply check the box 'Donate as an Organization' and include your company name. The receipt you receive to the email address used to make your contribution will include your business information.

Kada donirate putem našeg obrasca, jednostavno potvrdite okvir 'Doniraj kao organizacija' i upišite naziv svoje tvrtke. Potvrda koju primite na adresu e-pošte koju ste koristili za svoj doprinos uključivat će vaše poslovne podatke.

When you opt to cover our transaction costs, you're covering both our processing and donation platform costs. The costs associated with our robust online donation system allows us to continue scaling sustainably as our supporter-base grows. Our donation platform and payment processor partners reduce internal costs associated with maintaining our own system from scratch. Our partners ensure we can accept a wide range of currencies/payment methods and remain PCI compliant in all of the countries that we accept gifts from. The transaction costs donors may choose to cover are based on an estimate of our overall costs. Due to many factors actual costs may fluctuate.

Kada odlučite pokriti naše troškove transakcije, pokrivate troškove obrade transakcije i platforme za donacije. Troškovi povezani s našim online sustavom donacija omogućuju nam da nastavimo s održivim povećanjem kako naša baza podržavatelja raste. Naša platforma za donacije i partneri za obradu plaćanja smanjuju interne troškove povezane s održavanjem vlastitog sustava. Naši partneri osiguravaju da možemo prihvatiti širok raspon valuta i načina plaćanja i ostati PCI usklađeni u svim zemljama iz kojih prihvaćamo donacije. Transakcijski troškovi koje donatori mogu pokriti temelje se na procjeni naših ukupnih troškova. Zbog mnogih čimbenika stvarni troškovi mogu varirati.

Whether it’s work or play, you deserve to have privacy when you are online. A VPN, Virtual Private Network, can help you create a secure, private connection to the internet. So that when you are traveling, connecting to WiFi, or simply want more online security - you know that your information is protected from prying eyes.

Bez obzira radi li se o poslu ili zabavi, zaslužujete privatnost kada ste na mreži. VPN, virtualna privatna mreža, vam pomaže stvoriti sigurnu, privatnu vezu na Internet. Kada putujete i povezujete se na WiFi, ili jednostavno želite više sigurnosti - znate da vaše informacije su zaštićene od znatiželjih očiju.

Whether you are using it on a large desktop monitor or a small laptop touchscreen, you may want the icons and text of the interface to be larger and more spread out or very compact. In Thunderbird 91, under View -> Density in the menu, you can select the UI density for the entire application. Three options are available: compact (small), normal(medium), and touch(large).

Bez obzira da li ga koristite na velikom ekranu stolnog računala ili malom ekranu na dodir na prijenosnom računalu, možda želite da ikone i tekst sučelja budu veći i s većim razmakom između elemenata, ili vrlo kompaktno. U Thunderbirdu 91, pod Prikaz -> Zbijenost, možete odabrati gustoću korisničkog sučelja za cijelu aplikaciju. Dostupne su tri mogućnosti: kompaktno (malo), normalno (srednje) i za dodir (veliko).
